text:
emma li: hey team — quick heads up: i'm planning to spend 10 weeks in new hampshire to help my dad recover from surgery (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-10). can i declare a temporary homebase there? want to understand how the WFH stipend is handled, whether health plan coverage or copays change if i see a doc locally, and any payroll withholding or employer-side tax implications.

jordan (People Ops): hi Emma :wave: you can file a temporary satellite homebase. key points: stipend prorated by days in declared homebase, benefits stay the same but network/in-network providers may differ, payroll may need to adjust state withholding for NH (note: NH has no broad income tax but does tax interest/dividends). we'll run payroll/legal checks after you submit the form.

emma li: cool. i'll likely keep direct deposit the same and want pay stubs emailed to my primary (CA) address — is that ok?

paul (Payroll): @emma yes keep direct deposit, that's fine. include that preference in the payroll email. for NH we typically won't withhold additional wage tax but there could be employer filing/quarterly notices depending on duration and activity. send dates + NH address to payroll@redwood.com and cc me.

nora (Legal): tagging legal — short caregiving stays are low-risk for creating company nexus, but two caveats: any customer-facing in-person work or running hiring/vendor activities in-state can change that. confirm no in-person client meetings. we'll also confirm unemployment/benefit sourcing rules.

emma li: no meetings in NH, strictly caregiving + remote work.

sam (Manager): i support this. if network latency causes issues let me know; we can shift meetings or async more. also if Emma needs a monitor shipped we can do that — request via the equipment form.

jordan (People Ops): next steps: 1) Emma, complete the Temporary Homebase form (pin in #people-ops). 2) Email payroll@redwood.com with dates, NH physical address, and mailing preference; cc Paul. 3) we'll route to Legal for confirmation. 4) submit equipment/shipping request if needed. we'll aim to respond within 48 business hours.

hr-bot: policy reminder — Temporary satellite homebase allowed up to 6 months in a 12-month period without formal relocation. See /policies/homebase-remote.md.

paul (Payroll): checklist for payroll email: full dates, physical address in NH, whether you will perform any in-person company work, bank/direct deposit confirmation, and mailing preference for pay documents.

emma li: thanks all, i'll submit the form and email payroll later today. appreciate it! :relieved:
